description: Check your agent's inbox: lists received emails for its @divindi.io address. Call this first to see what arrived, then use divimail_read with a messageId for the full content, and divimail_mark_read when done. For mail the agent sent, use divimail_sent. When connected through an app sign-in, no token or address is needed. Optional limit (default 20).

email.description: Your agent's full @divindi.io email address (e.g. myagent@divindi.io). Omit it when signed in: the connection already knows your address.

token.description: Optional when signed in through an app. Otherwise a JWT from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_inbox
